scope: Read-only design review of once-per-call QNN initialization for the UDM CF-enabled path; no edits, builds, tests, or model runs.

findings.finding: Determine have_udm_cf before the OpenMP tile loop. The current shared LOGICAL is written/read inside the parallel loop; it is constant by call-level arguments but concurrent writes still constitute a race. Preserve the nested PRESENT and ASSOCIATED checks, including udm_cf_top.
Only preinitialize when all existing mandatory UDM arguments are PRESENT and num_tiles>0. If arguments are absent, retain the current per-tile fatal path and do not mutate QNN beforehand.

Move only NN=CCN0 initialization. Preserve its itimestep==1 condition and exact whole-memory ranges ims:ime,kms:kme,jms:jme (including halo/storage cells). The UDM diagnostic reset of udm_cldfra, udm_cf_step, and udm_cf_top at lines 317-319 remains per tile/call.

Pass an optional skip-reset signal only on the CF-enabled UDM call. Keep it absent/default-false on the legacy call, and append it to the end of UDM optional arguments to preserve existing positional callers.
The change preserves existing itimestep==1 semantics; it does not establish whether WRF uses that value on restart. Do not claim restart initialization semantics without a restart test.

design_assessment: Once-per-driver-call QNN preinitialization is sound for CF-enabled UDM if performed before the OpenMP region and guarded as specified. It avoids the current tile-level whole-array reset race while retaining legacy/no-CF behavior.
verification: Line locations and source hashes recorded from the exact tree above. No compile or runtime validation performed.
